acceptanceCriteria: internal/taskman decodeTicket accepts a ticket record carrying requiresPool and/or requiredRoles with valid values and still refuses unknown keys, wrong types and a missing base key.
A focused internal/taskman test fails before the fix (closed object member count) and passes after it.
The admitted optional-key set is shared with or checked against the native record codec, so a later optional key (issue 502 escalations) cannot silently diverge.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main cd70ba0a. internal/taskman/decode.go decodeTicket checks the record with object(v, ticketKeys), and object (internal/taskman/json.go:97) requires the member count to equal the 34 base keys of wire.TicketRecordKeys. The native record codec (internal/tasks/ticket/record.go:164) also admits the optional keys requiresPool and requiredRoles. Reproduction: a scratch test in internal/taskman added requiresPool or requiredRoles to the first fixture ticket record and called decodeTicket. Base record: nil error. With requiresPool: 'closed object member count'. With requiredRoles: the same. Expected: the Core read-only planner accepts every record the native codec writes, validating the optional keys rather than refusing them. Actual: one ticket with either key makes the whole ticket export capture (internal/taskman/capture.go:182) fail. Issue 502 (ESC-V0-002) adds a third optional key, escalations, and requires the Core reader to preserve it, so the fix should admit a named optional-key set, not only these two. Inference: no test feeds Core a record with an optional key.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0754: commit 0a3e2db4; AC1: internal/taskman/decode.go validates optional values and rejects unknown/missing keys; issue502_test.go covers admission/refusal. AC2: 2026-10-04-issue502-record-key.md retains the restored exact-count negative control; candidate-3 full-gate evidence covers the repaired tests. AC3: Core and native record.go share taskswire.TicketRecordOptionalKeys. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch D) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: Core taskman capture refuses tickets carrying the optional requiresPool or requiredRoles record keys
